# 2 Clement — Chapter 6 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 6
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. The Lord says plainly: "No slave can serve two masters." Trying to serve both God and money will destroy us.
2. "What good does it do someone to win the whole world but lose their own soul?"
3. This present age and the age to come are at war with each other.
4. This age promotes adultery, corruption, greed, and deception. The coming age leaves all of that behind.
5. We cannot be friends with both. We have to let this age go and commit ourselves to the next.
6. We believe it is better to despise what belongs here and to love what belongs there. We should stop trying to please people and start trying to please God — the way we once did.
7. The Lord's words stand: "No slave can serve two masters." Serve both God and Mammon, and you will be the worse for it. "What does it profit someone to gain the whole world and forfeit their soul?"
